claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item_or_object_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form transforms the staff itself after planting it in the ground. The current activation attachment grammar cannot target the held item/object honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.fall_on_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The taxonomy already recognizes this cleanup rider, but the authored surface and tracer do not expose it. Tree Form needs it for the revert clause.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.lose_properties_on_last_charge_roll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The last-charge rider is a permanent magical shutdown, not destruction. Current destruction variants can only destroy the item or do nothing.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff."

discrepancies: tracer emitted atom 'item_destruction' not in claude's claim
